To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new approach for optimal dynamic role assignment and physics-based trajectory planning in RoboCUp.

we present a novel hybrid dynamic systems approach for optimal dynamic multi-robot cooperation that integrates dynamic role and action sequencing and assignment with physics-based trajectory planning.
the proposed approach is capable to plan and optimize the hybrid state trajectories of the multi-robot system for optimal multi-robots cooperation in RoboCupsoccer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a formal framework for optimal multi- robot cooperation in dynamic and uncertain environments.
the development of a new approach for multi-robot cooperation based on the concept of hybrid dynamic systems.
the development of new methods and algorithms to solve complex problems of optimal dynamic role assignment and multi-robot cooperation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the approach presented in this thesis has been successfully applied in a real-time capable and highly efficient software architecture for multi-robot cooperation in the RoboCrap scenario.
the presented approach is a promising and novel paradigm for the design of optimal multi-robot systems.
this paper presents the most complete and detailed work on multi-robot cooperation in the literature to date.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a hybrid dynamic systems approach is an appropriate and promising approach to model and solve problems in the area of multi-robot cooperation.
we have developed a novel approach to multi-robot cooperation that enables a formal coupling of the discrete and continuous dynamics and that can be applied to any multi-robot cooperation task.
we have developed a novel approach for optimal multi- robot cooperation based on a formal and rigorous mathematical description and analysis of the system dynamics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presented formal approach is a promising candidate for the design of multi-robot control architectures and methodologies.
a hybrid dynamic systems approach is a promising way to formalize the dynamic cooperation between mobile robots.
the hybrid dynamic systems approach enables to integrate the physical motion behavior and the dynamic role assignment and sequencing of a team of robots in a formal and tight way.
